settings.breed_blurb: World's smallest dog with the biggest personality — Chihuahuas love being pampered and look absolutely adorable dressed up.
settings.tip_lehenga: XS lehengas with the smallest neck opening are ideal for Chihuahuas. Look for lightweight fabrics to avoid overwhelming their tiny frame.
settings.tip_sherwani: A micro-embroidered XS sherwani makes a Chihuahua look like the most important guest at any celebration.
settings.tip_tshirt: XS tees in very soft, lightweight jersey keep Chihuahuas warm (they get cold easily!) without restricting movement.
settings.tip_colours: Bright, bold colours like fuchsia, electric blue and canary yellow make Chihuahuas pop in photos. Tiny dogs deserve big colour!
